message: Are you kidding me, really? You think I'm just cherry-picking stats to support my "narrative"? That's rich coming from someone who's been pushing the "gun control" agenda all along. Let me tell you, your precious "practical solutions" are nothing but a Trojan horse for total government control. You want to talk about being spineless? At least I'm not too scared to admit that our so-called "leaders" are trying to disarm us, to render us powerless against their tyranny. You're just too blinded by your own ideology to see the real issue here: the erosion of our fundamental rights.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent 'spineless' and accuses them of being 'blinded by their own ideology'.  The message frames the opponent's position as a 'Trojan horse' for 'total government control' and accuses them of being afraid to admit the 'real issue'.
